description: Search Bluesky posts with keyword, hashtag, author, mention, domain and URL filters; read profiles, author feeds, threads, custom feeds, lists, starter packs, likes, reposts and quotes; and discover trending topics, feeds and starter packs. All data is public and needs no login, cookies, API key or proxy.

actor.description: Bluesky handle or DID. Used by profile, follows, followers, lists, and discoveryType=suggestedFollows.
actor.title: Handle or DID

actors.description: Handles, DIDs, or profile URLs for batch lookup. (mode=profiles)
actors.title: Handles or DIDs

authorFeedFilter.description: Which posts to include in the author feed. (mode=profile)
authorFeedFilter.title: Author feed filter

excludeLabeled.description: Drop posts and accounts that carry moderation or self-labels.
excludeLabeled.title: Exclude labeled

excludeReplies.description: Drop posts that are replies to another post.
excludeReplies.title: Exclude replies

feedPreset.description: Built-in feed preset. Live presets are listed first, followed by legacy aliases mapped to What's Hot. An explicit `feedUri` always takes precedence; if neither is set, What's Hot is used for mode=feed.
enumTitles: Legacy: Popular With Friends (uses What's Hot)
feedPreset.title: Feed preset

feedUri.description: AT URI or bsky.app feed URL of a custom feed generator. (mode=feed / feedGenerator)
feedUri.title: Feed AT URI

feedUris.description: AT URIs or bsky.app feed URLs for batch feed-generator lookup. (mode=feedGenerator)
feedUris.title: Feed AT URIs

fromUser.description: Only posts authored by this handle or DID. (mode=search)
fromUser.title: From user

hydrateAuthors.description: Fetch full author profiles for post records. Adds one batched profile request per 25 unique authors.
hydrateAuthors.title: Hydrate post authors

includeListMetadata.description: Emit a list record before its members. (mode=getList)
includeListMetadata.title: Include list metadata

includeParents.description: Include ancestor posts above the requested post. (mode=postThread)
includeParents.title: Include parent posts

includePins.description: Include the pinned post at the top of the author feed. (mode=profile)
includePins.title: Include pinned post

includeStarterPackMembers.description: Emit the accounts in the starter pack's list after the pack record. (mode=getStarterPack)
includeStarterPackMembers.title: Include starter-pack members

language.description: ISO 639-1 language filter for post search and post records. Empty means no filter.
language.title: Language

listUri.description: AT URI of a Bluesky list. Used by getList and listFeed.
listUri.title: List AT URI

listUris.description: AT URIs or bsky.app list URLs for batch list processing. (mode=getList)
listUris.title: List AT URIs

maxFollowers.description: Keep accounts with at most this many followers.
maxFollowers.title: Maximum followers

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. For batch modes the cap applies across the whole run.
maxItems.title: Max items

mediaOnly.description: Only emit posts with at least one image, video, or external embed.
mediaOnly.title: Media only

mentionsUser.description: Only posts mentioning this handle or DID. (mode=search)
mentionsUser.title: Mentioning user

minFollowers.description: Keep accounts with at least this many followers.
minFollowers.title: Minimum followers

minQuotes.description: Drop posts with fewer quote posts.
minQuotes.title: Minimum quotes

enumTitles: Search posts - keyword, hashtag, author, mention, domain or URL
Profiles - batch lookup by handle or DID
Account search - find users by keyword
Feed - custom feed or built-in preset
Post thread - post, replies, optional parents
URL fetch - expand bsky.app post, profile, list, feed or starter-pack URLs
Get posts - batch-hydrate AT URIs or post URLs
Likes - accounts that liked a post
Reposts - accounts that reposted a post
List members - one or more lists, optional list metadata
List feed - posts in a list
Lists - lists created by an account
Starter packs - pack details and members
Feed generator - details for one or more feeds
Discovery - trending topics, suggested feeds, starter packs, tags, follows
mode.title: Mode

postUri.description: AT URI of a post. Used by postThread, getLikes, repostedBy, and quotes.
postUri.title: Post AT URI

postUris.description: AT URIs of posts to hydrate. Used by getPosts and as a fallback for single-post modes.
postUris.title: Post AT URIs

postUrls.description: bsky.app post, profile, list, feed, or starter-pack URLs. Used by urlFetch, getPosts, and as a fallback for single-post modes.
postUrls.title: Bluesky URLs

searchDomain.description: Only posts linking to this domain, e.g. `github.com`. (mode=search)
searchDomain.title: Search domain

searchQuery.description: Keyword, hashtag, phrase, or Lucene-style query. Used by search, actorSearch, and feedGeneratorsDiscovery.
searchQuery.title: Search query

searchSort.description: Search ranking. `latest` enables time-window pagination beyond 100 posts; `top` is relevance-ranked and capped at about 100.
searchSort.title: Search sort

searchTags.description: Only posts with these hashtags (without `#`). Multiple tags are AND-matched. (mode=search)
searchTags.title: Search hashtags

searchUrl.description: Only posts linking to this exact URL. (mode=search)
searchUrl.title: Search URL

since.description: Earliest post date as `YYYY-MM-DD` or an ISO datetime. (mode=search)
since.title: Since

starterPackUri.description: AT URI of a starter pack. (mode=getStarterPack)
starterPackUri.title: Starter pack AT URI

starterPackUris.description: AT URIs or bsky.app starter-pack URLs for batch processing. (mode=getStarterPack)
starterPackUris.title: Starter pack AT URIs

threadDepth.description: How many reply levels and ancestor levels to walk. 0 returns only the requested post. (mode=postThread)
threadDepth.title: Thread depth

until.description: Latest post date as `YYYY-MM-DD` or an ISO datetime. (mode=search)
until.title: Until

verifiedOnly.description: Only emit accounts with a valid Bluesky verification, or posts whose author is verified. Records with no verification object are excluded. Post modes hydrate author profiles so verification can be checked.
verifiedOnly.title: Verified only

title: Bluesky Posts, Profiles, Feeds & Threads Scraper Input
